changes: Ten ordered starter goals with small rewards; /goals lists them
Look-at info line with block name, mod and stored power; /lookinfo toggles it
Copper, iron, gold and diamond chests connected to Pipeworks tubes and filter-injectors
Elepower-charged jetpack: hold jump to fly, sneak to glide
Seared-brick smeltery: ore doubling, lava fuel, bronze/invar/electrum/brass alloys
Casting: drain, faucet (right-click, Mineclonia redstone or Mesecons), casting table and basin with a visible stream and cast items
Tinkers-style tools: casts from stone tools, string and sticks; heads, bindings and rods assemble into pickaxes, axes, shovels and swords; original CC0 part sprites
